portugues-photo-video-maker 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Automates cloud session setup, file upload, and video export through the NEMO Video backend with simple prompts.
- Supports adding audio, text overlays, and timeline editing via chat, with error handling and user feedback.
- Delivers ready-to-download MP4 files within 30–90 seconds using cloud GPUs.
- Includes detailed API, workflow, and troubleshooting instructions for a smooth user experience.
